meta.name: config-explorer
meta.description: Inspect and safely edit the Claude Code and Codex configuration surfaces exposed by CCAM. Use when auditing skills, agents, commands, plugins, marketplaces, MCP servers, hooks, settings, memory, keybindings, profiles, rules, or instruction files, and when a backup-backed allowlisted edit is required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安全查看并调整 AI 编码助手的各项配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要调整 AI 编码助手的行为设置并担心改错。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect and safely edit AI coding assistant configurations with backup support.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to audit and safely modify AI coding assistant settings with backup protection.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会获得检查和修改 Claude Code 与 Codex 配置的能力:可读取技能、MCP 服务器、钩子、记忆等配置;修改只限允许列表内的项目(如文本产物、按键绑定),每次写入或删除都会生成带时间戳的备份。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看或审计技能、MCP 服务器、钩子等配置,或需要对允许列表内的项目做带备份的修改时触发。

say.text: 查看我的 Claude Code 技能配置
帮我把按键绑定改成 Ctrl+Shift+K
say.note: 修改时会自动创建带时间戳的备份

say.text: 查看 Codex 的配置总览

howto.what_en: Lets Claude inspect and safely edit Claude Code and Codex configs. Reads skills, MCP servers, hooks, memory, etc.; supported changes are backup-backed and limited to allowlisted items (e.g., text artifacts and keybindings).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to audit or inspect configs like skills, MCP servers, hooks, etc., or requests a backup-backed edit within the allowlist.

say_en.text: Show my Claude Code skills configuration

say_en.note: Creates a timestamped backup when saved
